---
title: "`r params$title`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    theme: flatly
    highlight: tango
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
      smooth_scroll: true
    toc_depth: 3
    number_sections: false
params:
  result_df:    NULL   # data.frame – full TALOS results
  plot_widgets: NULL   # named list of plotly htmlwidgets, key = "<sample>_<gene>"
  gene_configs: NULL   # named list of resolved gene config lists
  has_plotly:   false  # logical – whether plotly is available
  show_config:  false  # logical – render per-gene configuration block
  title:        "TALOS Analysis Report"
  mode:         "itd"  # "itd" | "alu"   (controls column names & section labels)
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

library(DT)
if (isTRUE(params$has_plotly)) {
  library(plotly)
  library(htmltools)
}

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.fmt_pct <- function(x, digits = 1L)
  ifelse(is.na(x), "N/A", paste0(round(x, digits), "%"))

.fmt_na <- function(x)
  ifelse(is.na(x) | x == "", "N/A", as.character(x))

# Some columns (e.g. LeftSoftclipPctSupport) get pre-formatted into "56.4%"
# strings below for the summary table, while others (e.g. LeftSoftclipPctWT)
# stay raw numeric. This parses either shape back to one decimal safely,
# instead of re-running as.numeric() on an already-%-suffixed string (which
# returns NA and was previously silently displayed as 0).
.fmt_pct_val <- function(x) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", as.character(x))))
  ifelse(is.na(v), "N/A", sprintf("%.1f", v))
}

# Columns we never show in the summary table (internal / verbose)
.HIDE_COLS <- c(
  "ITD_Sequence", "ITDCoverageRLE", "SequenceImputed", "SequencePartial",
  # ALU-mode internals
  "ALU_RawScore", "TSD_RawSeq_Left", "TSD_RawSeq_Right"
)

# ── Tidy result_df for display ─────────────────────────────────────────────
result_df <- params$result_df

if (!is.null(result_df) && nrow(result_df) > 0) {
  if ("AlleleFrequency" %in% colnames(result_df))
    result_df$AlleleFrequency <- .fmt_pct(result_df$AlleleFrequency * 100)
  if ("LeftSoftclipPctSupport" %in% colnames(result_df))
    result_df$LeftSoftclipPctSupport  <- .fmt_pct(result_df$LeftSoftclipPctSupport)
  if ("RightSoftclipPctSupport" %in% colnames(result_df))
    result_df$RightSoftclipPctSupport <- .fmt_pct(result_df$RightSoftclipPctSupport)
  if ("LeftSoftclipPctWT" %in% colnames(result_df))
    result_df$LeftSoftclipPctWT  <- .fmt_pct(result_df$LeftSoftclipPctWT)
  if ("RightSoftclipPctWT" %in% colnames(result_df))
    result_df$RightSoftclipPctWT <- .fmt_pct(result_df$RightSoftclipPctWT)
  # ALU-specific columns
  if ("PolyALength" %in% colnames(result_df))
    result_df$PolyALength <- .fmt_na(result_df$PolyALength)

  # Genome Build isn't a column of result_df itself -- like the PDF, it comes
  # from each row's gene config -- so it's derived here and placed right
  # after Gene for parity with the PDF's per-variant "Genome Build" row.
  if ("Gene" %in% colnames(result_df)) {
    result_df$GenomeBuild <- vapply(result_df$Gene, function(g) {
      cfg <- params$gene_configs[[g]]
      if (is.null(cfg) || is.null(cfg$build) || is.na(cfg$build)) "custom" else as.character(cfg$build)
    }, character(1))
    ord <- names(result_df)
    gene_pos <- match("Gene", ord)
    ord <- append(ord[ord != "GenomeBuild"], "GenomeBuild", after = gene_pos)
    result_df <- result_df[, ord, drop = FALSE]
  }
}

cols_show  <- setdiff(names(result_df), .HIDE_COLS)
df_display <- if (!is.null(result_df)) result_df[, cols_show, drop = FALSE] else data.frame()

is_alu <- isTRUE(params$mode == "alu")
event_label <- if (is_alu) "insertion" else "ITD"
Events_label <- if (is_alu) "ALU Insertions" else "ITDs"
```

---

## Results summary

```{r results-table}
if (nrow(df_display) == 0) {
  cat("*No variants detected.*\n")
} else {
  DT::datatable(
    df_display,
    filter     = "top",
    rownames   = FALSE,
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options    = list(
      scrollX    = TRUE,
      pageLength = 25,
      dom        = "Bfrtip",
      buttons    = list("copy", "csv", "excel"),
      columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-center", targets = "_all"))
    ),
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = "caption-side: top; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1em;",
      sprintf(
        "%s detected: %d %s across %d sample(s)",
        Events_label,
        nrow(result_df),
        event_label,
        length(unique(result_df$Sample))
      )
    )
  )
}
```

---

## Variant details

```{r variant-details, results='asis'}
if (is.null(result_df) || nrow(result_df) == 0) {
  cat("*No variants detected.*\n")
} else {
  groups <- unique(result_df[, c("Sample", "Gene"), drop = FALSE])

  for (gi in seq_len(nrow(groups))) {
    sn <- groups$Sample[gi]
    gn <- groups$Gene[gi]

    cat(sprintf("\n\n### Sample: %s \u2014 %s\n\n", sn, gn))

    # ── Interactive plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # NB: printing an htmlwidget directly inside a for-loop mixed with cat()
    # (as opposed to it being the sole, top-level auto-printed value of a
    # chunk) does not reliably get its JS library picked up by pandoc's
    # self-contained bundling -- the widget's container div and data get
    # written out, but the Plotly.js runtime itself silently gets dropped,
    # so nothing ever renders.
    #
    # The fix is NOT to re-bundle the whole ~3-4MB Plotly.js library per
    # widget (an earlier version of this did that via saveWidget()+iframe,
    # which is why the report started eating all the RAM/disk with more
    # than a few variants). Instead, register each widget's dependency
    # directly into knitr's own metadata store with knit_meta_add() -- this
    # is the same mechanism the auto-print path uses, it dedupes across
    # calls, so Plotly.js still only gets embedded ONCE for the whole
    # document (exactly like jQuery/DataTables already do for the two DT
    # tables above), no matter how many sample/gene widgets are printed.
    if (isTRUE(params$has_plotly)) {
      key <- paste(sn, gn, sep = "_")
      wgt <- params$plot_widgets[[key]]
      if (!is.null(wgt)) {
        wgt_tags <- htmltools::as.tags(wgt)
        knitr::knit_meta_add(htmltools::findDependencies(wgt_tags))
        cat(htmltools::renderTags(wgt_tags)$html)
        cat("\n")
      } else {
        cat("*Interactive plot not available for this sample/gene.*\n")
      }
    }

    sub_df <- result_df[result_df$Sample == sn & result_df$Gene == gn, , drop = FALSE]

    # Same lookup plot_talos_report() uses for the PDF's "Genome Build" row --
    # this isn't a column on result_df itself, it comes from the gene config.
    grp_cfg <- params$gene_configs[[gn]]
    grp_genome_build <- if (is.null(grp_cfg) || is.null(grp_cfg$build) || is.na(grp_cfg$build)) "custom" else as.character(grp_cfg$build)

    for (vi in seq_len(nrow(sub_df))) {
      row <- sub_df[vi, ]

      if (is_alu) {
        # ── ALU-mode header ──────────────────────────────────────────
        hdr <- sprintf(
          "ALU insertion %d @ %s (%s)",
          vi,
          .fmt_na(row$InsertionSite),
          .fmt_na(row$ALUSubtype)
        )
        cat(sprintf("\n\n#### %s\n\n", hdr))
        cat(sprintf("* **Insertion site:** %s\n",     .fmt_na(row$InsertionSite)))
        cat(sprintf("* **ALU subtype:** %s\n",        .fmt_na(row$ALUSubtype)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Orientation:** %s\n",        .fmt_na(row$ALUOrientation)))
        cat(sprintf("* **TSD length:** %s bp\n",      .fmt_na(row$TSD_Length)))
        cat(sprintf("* **TSD sequence:** `%s`\n",     .fmt_na(row$TSD_Sequence)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Poly-A tail:** %s nt\n",     .fmt_na(row$PolyALength)))
        cat(sprintf("* **5\u2019 truncation:** %s bp\n", .fmt_na(row$ALU5pTruncation)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Supporting reads:** %s\n",   .fmt_na(row$SupportingReads)))
        cat(sprintf("* **VAF:** %s\n",                .fmt_pct(as.numeric(sub("%", "", row$AlleleFrequency)))))
        cat(sprintf("* **Mean MAPQ:** %s\n",          .fmt_na(row$MeanSupportMAPQ)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Hotspot:** %s\n",
          if (isTRUE(row$Hotspot)) .fmt_na(row$HotspotName) else "No"))
        if (!is.na(row$ALU_Sequence) && nchar(as.character(row$ALU_Sequence)) > 0) {
          cat(sprintf(
            "* **Matched ALU sequence:** <details><summary>Show (%d bp)</summary><pre>%s</pre></details>\n",
            nchar(as.character(row$ALU_Sequence)),
            row$ALU_Sequence
          ))
        }
      } else {
        # ── ITD-mode header ──────────────────────────────────────────
        # This list is field-for-field identical to the 32-row "Variant
        # Summary" table on page 2 of plot_talos_report()'s PDF -- same
        # metrics, same order, same labels -- so the two reports are
        # directly comparable. Sample/Gene/Genome Build are repeated here
        # per variant (as they are per ITD column in the PDF) even though
        # they're also shown in the section header above.
        hgvs_str <- .fmt_na(row$HGVS_cDNA)
        cat(sprintf("\n\n#### Variant %d: %s\n\n", vi, hgvs_str))
        cat(sprintf("* **Sample:** %s\n",             .fmt_na(sn)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Gene:** %s\n",               .fmt_na(row$Gene)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Genome Build:** %s\n",       grp_genome_build))
        cat(sprintf("* **Genomic Position:** %s\n",   .fmt_na(row$GenomicPosition)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Length (bp):** %d\n",        as.integer(row$Length)))
        pe_str <- if (!is.null(row$LengthPE) && !is.na(row$LengthPE))
          sprintf("%d bp (%d pairs)", as.integer(row$LengthPE),
                  as.integer(if (!is.null(row$LengthPE_NSpanning)) row$LengthPE_NSpanning else 0L))
        else "N/A"
        cat(sprintf("* **Length PE (bp):** %s\n", pe_str))
        cat(sprintf("* **Length Ext (bp):** %s\n",
          ifelse(is.null(row$LengthExt) || is.na(row$LengthExt), "N/A", as.character(row$LengthExt))))
        cat(sprintf("* **VAF (%%):** %s\n",
          if ("AlleleFrequency" %in% names(row)) row$AlleleFrequency
          else .fmt_pct(row$AlleleFrequency_raw * 100)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Supporting Reads:** %s\n",   .fmt_na(row$SupportingReads)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Wildtype Reads:** %s\n",     .fmt_na(row$WildtypeReads)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Depth at Breakpoint:** %s\n",.fmt_na(row$DepthAtBreakpoint)))
        cat(sprintf("* **HGVS cDNA:** `%s`\n",        .fmt_na(row$HGVS_cDNA)))
        cat(sprintf("* **HGVS Protein:** `%s`\n",     .fmt_na(row$HGVS_Protein)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Region:** %s\n",             .fmt_na(row$Region)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Exon Number:** %s\n",        .fmt_na(row$ExonNumber)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Orientation:** %s\n",        .fmt_na(row$Orientation)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Hotspot:** %s\n",
          if (isTRUE(row$Hotspot)) .fmt_na(row$HotspotName) else "No"))
        cat(sprintf("* **Strand Bias:** %s\n",
          ifelse(is.na(row$StrandBias), "N/A", sprintf("%.3f", row$StrandBias))))
        cat(sprintf("* **Mean MAPQ:** %s\n",
          ifelse(is.na(row$MeanSupportMAPQ), "N/A", sprintf("%.1f", row$MeanSupportMAPQ))))
        cat(sprintf("* **Support Consistency:** %s\n",
          ifelse(is.na(row$SupportConsistency), "N/A", paste0(round(row$SupportConsistency), "%"))))
        cat(sprintf("* **RefMatch (%%):** %s\n",      .fmt_pct(row$RefMatch_Observed)))
        cat(sprintf("* **ITD Read Coverage (%%):** %s\n", .fmt_pct(row$ITDReadCoverage)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Sequence Source:** %s\n",    .fmt_na(row$SequenceSource)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Left Softclip Count:** %s\n",  ifelse(is.na(row$LeftSoftclipCount), "0", as.character(row$LeftSoftclipCount))))
        cat(sprintf("* **Right Softclip Count:** %s\n", ifelse(is.na(row$RightSoftclipCount), "0", as.character(row$RightSoftclipCount))))
        cat(sprintf("* **Left Softclip %% (Support):** %s\n",  .fmt_pct_val(row$LeftSoftclipPctSupport)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Right Softclip %% (Support):** %s\n", .fmt_pct_val(row$RightSoftclipPctSupport)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Left Softclip %% (WT):** %s\n",       .fmt_pct_val(row$LeftSoftclipPctWT)))
        cat(sprintf("* **Right Softclip %% (WT):** %s\n",      .fmt_pct_val(row$RightSoftclipPctWT)))
        cat(sprintf("* **PE Softclip Support:** %s\n",
          ifelse(is.null(row$PESoftclipSupport) || is.na(row$PESoftclipSupport), "N/A", as.character(row$PESoftclipSupport))))
        cat(sprintf("* **PE Event-size Pairs:** %s\n",
          ifelse(is.null(row$PESoftclipEventPairs) || is.na(row$PESoftclipEventPairs), "N/A", as.character(row$PESoftclipEventPairs))))
        cat(sprintf("* **PE Long-span Pairs:** %s\n",
          ifelse(is.null(row$PESoftclipLongPairs) || is.na(row$PESoftclipLongPairs), "N/A", as.character(row$PESoftclipLongPairs))))
        cat(sprintf("* **PE Orientation:** %s\n",
          ifelse(is.null(row$PEOrientationDominant) || is.na(row$PEOrientationDominant), "N/A",
                 sprintf("%s (FR=%s RF=%s FF=%s RR=%s)", row$PEOrientationDominant,
                         .fmt_na(row$PEOrientationFR), .fmt_na(row$PEOrientationRF),
                         .fmt_na(row$PEOrientationFF), .fmt_na(row$PEOrientationRR)))))
        if (!is.na(row$ITD_Sequence) && nchar(as.character(row$ITD_Sequence)) > 0) {
          cat(sprintf(
            "* **ITD Sequence:** <details><summary>Show (%d bp)</summary><pre>%s</pre></details>\n",
            nchar(as.character(row$ITD_Sequence)),
            row$ITD_Sequence
          ))
        }
      }
    }

    # ── Per-gene config block ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (isTRUE(params$show_config) && !is.null(params$gene_configs[[gn]])) {
      cfg <- params$gene_configs[[gn]]
      cat("\n\n#### Analysis configuration\n\n")
      cat(sprintf("* **Build:** %s\n",           ifelse(is.null(cfg$build) || is.na(cfg$build), "custom", cfg$build)))
      cat(sprintf("* **Chromosome:** %s\n",      .fmt_na(cfg$chrom)))
      cat(sprintf("* **Strand:** %s\n",          .fmt_na(cfg$strand)))
      cat(sprintf("* **Transcript:** %s\n",      ifelse(is.na(cfg$transcript), "none", cfg$transcript)))
      cat(sprintf("* **CDS offset:** %d\n",      cfg$cds_offset))
      cat(sprintf("* **Targeted exons:** %s\n",  paste(unique(cfg$target_exons$exon_idx), collapse = ", ")))
      cat(sprintf("* **Genomic window:** %d\u2013%d\n", cfg$genomic_start, cfg$genomic_end))
      cat(sprintf("* **min_support:** %s\n",         as.character(cfg$gene_settings$min_support %||% "default")))
      cat(sprintf("* **cluster_tolerance:** %s\n",   as.character(cfg$gene_settings$cluster_tolerance %||% "default")))
      cat(sprintf("* **min_mapq:** %s\n",            as.character(cfg$gene_settings$min_mapq %||% "default")))
    }
  }
}
```

## Run information

```{r run-info}
info_df <- data.frame(
  Item  = c("Report generated", "TALOS version", "R version",
            "Total variants", "Samples", "Genes", "Mode"),
  Value = c(
    format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
    tryCatch(as.character(utils::packageVersion("TALOS")), error = function(e) "dev"),
    R.version.string,
    as.character(if (is.null(result_df)) 0L else nrow(result_df)),
    paste(unique(result_df$Sample), collapse = ", "),
    paste(unique(result_df$Gene),   collapse = ", "),
    toupper(params$mode)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

DT::datatable(
  info_df,
  rownames  = FALSE,
  filter    = "none",
  options   = list(dom = "t", paging = FALSE, ordering = FALSE),
  colnames  = c("", "")
)
```
